articles.title: Trump calls reported FBI database hack not good
articles.summary: The FBI is reportedly investigating a security breach involving the National Crime Information Center. The incident has drawn public attention, with Donald Trump describing the reported database hack as not good.

articles.title: Top AI agents designed to live in text messages
articles.summary: A curated list highlights the most notable artificial intelligence agents capable of operating directly inside text messages, ranging from general daily assistants to specialized tools built for families, travel, and work.

articles.title: Actor licenses digital face to microdrama startup
articles.summary: An actor has licensed an artificial intelligence version of his face to a microdrama startup, mirroring a popular trend in China. Industry experts are raising questions about the long-term consequences if this practice spreads to Hollywood.

articles.title: Alaska governor-elect known for thousands of Wikipedia edits
articles.summary: Jonathan Kreiss-Tomkins, the governor-elect of Alaska, has a unique background as an active contributor to online platforms, having made more than 13,000 edits to Wikipedia over time.

articles.title: Startup sues Apple in India over sharing feature
articles.summary: A United States startup is suing Apple in India, seeking 162 million dollars in damages and a preliminary injunction that could impact the import of iPhones and Apple Watches into the country.

articles.title: Experts warn AI workers are vulnerable to honey-trap schemes
articles.summary: Technology professionals developing advanced systems that impact the global landscape may be facing personal security risks, as experts warn that nearly everyone in the artificial intelligence sector is susceptible to honey-trap plots.

articles.title: Spotify founder backs AI researcher fusion startup
articles.summary: Spotify founder Daniel Ek is investing in Europa Fusion, a newly established fusion power startup created by an artificial intelligence researcher to develop advanced energy generation technologies.

articles.title: AI and human claim solutions to Riemann hypothesis
articles.summary: Mathematicians are expressing astonishment after an artificial intelligence system claimed a potential solution to the 167-year-old Riemann hypothesis, arriving alongside a competing solution proposed by a human researcher.

articles.title: Super-hot rock geothermal could solve data center energy
articles.summary: New geothermal energy startups are betting on innovative technologies to surpass current market leaders, aiming to deliver terawatts of electricity nearly anywhere to support growing data center demands.

articles.title: Financing challenges face chips in space environments
articles.summary: Lenders are hesitant to allow SpaceX to launch financial collateral into orbit, raising critical questions about the future funding and viability of space-based data centers and orbital hardware.

articles.title: Bending Spoons acquires Mailchimp for 3.68 billion dollars
articles.summary: Bending Spoons has purchased Mailchimp for 3.68 billion dollars. This comes after Intuit previously acquired the same company in 2021 for roughly 12 billion dollars, marking a steep discount.

articles.title: Transcription firm exposes police and tech data online
articles.summary: A security lapse at a transcription firm used by police prosecutors and tech giants left sensitive customer data exposed on a cloud server without password protection, including police interviews and bodycam footage.

articles.title: UN fails to reach agreement on killer robots rules
articles.summary: United Nations diplomats meeting in Geneva concluded a largely fruitless week of negotiations without agreeing on binding regulations for autonomous weapons, ultimately deciding only to start discussing options moving forward.

articles.title: FBI and USDA report recent cyberattacks
articles.summary: Both the United States Department of Agriculture and the FBI were reportedly hacked. The incident marks the second recent cyberattack targeting the FBI, specifically hitting the National Crime Information Center used by law enforcement.

articles.title: Amazon digital photo frame gets Black Friday discount
articles.summary: Amazon has slashed prices on its newly released digital photo frame for Black Friday. Customers can find the Alexa Photo Frame discounted significantly at major retailers, making it a popular holiday gift option.

articles.title: Anker wireless earbuds drop to lowest price
articles.summary: The Soundcore Liberty 5 Pro wireless earbuds from Anker are currently on sale at major retailers for a record-low price of 129.99 dollars, down from their standard retail price of 169.99 dollars.

articles.title: Chess.com expands into classic games hub platform
articles.summary: Chess.com is expanding beyond chess by launching a new Classic Games platform that includes ten traditional games such as mahjong, sudoku, backgammon, and a Scrabble alternative following its earlier poker site launch.

articles.title: Xiaomi 18 Pro tests usefulness of dual screens
articles.summary: Xiaomi has introduced its new 18 Pro and Pro Max flagship smartphones globally, giving international users their first real opportunity to evaluate whether a secondary screen placed on the back of the device provides practical utility.

articles.title: EV startup Harbinger secures funding and major orders
articles.summary: Electric truck maker Harbinger has raised 240 million dollars in a Series D funding round, bolstered by a 300 million dollar order from FedEx and a new defense contract with the United States military.

articles.title: Modern genetics refutes claims of race realism
articles.summary: Scientific consensus in modern genetics does not support pseudoscientific claims regarding race realism, clearly demonstrating that genetic data fails to validate assertions of innate racial differences in human intelligence.

articles.title: Trump FCC blocks California phone service rules
articles.summary: The Federal Communications Commission has moved to preempt state-level regulations in California, ruling that the state is not allowed to enforce rules requiring carriers like AT and T to maintain traditional home phone services.

articles.title: Google updates search homepage with AI chat history
articles.summary: Google is rolling out a redesigned search homepage that incorporates direct access to artificial intelligence chat history while removing the traditional search button to streamline user interactions.

articles.title: Meta reconsiders 2030 net-zero goals amid AI emissions
articles.summary: Meta is re-evaluating its sustainability goals for 2030 as record-breaking energy consumption and greenhouse gas emissions from expanding artificial intelligence data centers complicate corporate environmental targets.

articles.title: Researcher exposes privacy flaws in AI supply chain
articles.summary: An experiment involving unique trackable secrets embedded into artificial intelligence training prompts revealed significant data privacy vulnerabilities, proving that sensitive information often leaks through the supply chain.

articles.title: Astronomers observe star swallowing its neighbor
articles.summary: A recent unexpected brightening observed in space was successfully tracked to a rare stellar event where one giant star orbited inside and was ultimately swallowed by its neighbor before exploding.

articles.title: Prisons permitted to jam contraband mobile phones
articles.summary: Prisons have received official authorization to deploy technology that jams contraband cell phones, though industry groups warn that testing shows the signal interference can accidentally disrupt nearby consumer devices up to two miles away.

articles.title: Army delays detonating hazardous lead azide material
articles.summary: The Army has postponed plans to detonate catastrophically hazardous lead azide explosive materials following intense public concern and predictive computer modeling showing a neurotoxic lead plume could travel up to 100 miles.

articles.title: Valve warns of potential price hikes for Steam Machines
articles.summary: Valve has indicated that it may be forced to increase the retail price of its supply-limited Steam Machines, noting that manufacturing volume constraints and final production costs remain uncertain.

articles.title: Examining why Apple Vision Pro lagged behind Meta
articles.summary: Despite generating massive hype upon its debut in 2024, Apple's high-end mixed-reality headset has struggled to achieve widespread market adoption in the years following its release compared to competing devices.
